jobs.description:
Local Job Overview: Chicago

Job Title: Overnight Warehouse Associate (Gig/Contract) Hiring Organization: Amazon Based in: Chicago, IL (our growing Chicago office)

Compensation: $21-$25/Hour (approx. $48.4k/Year) Benefits: This role offers competitive pay. Set your own schedule.

Day-to-Day

Core objectives involve your professional skills in Logistics.

  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our Amazon team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Logistics industry.

Rule the Night, Fuel the Morning

While the rest of the city sleeps, the Amazon network kicks into its highest gear. The night shift is the undisputed powerhouse of our distribution model. Everything accomplished overnight determines the success of the delivery fleet the following morning. If you are a dedicated night owl seeking highly lucrative Amazon warehouse jobs with less congestion and massive earning potential, the Overnight Warehouse Associate role is your perfect entry into thriving logistics careers.

Why the Graveyard Shift Dominates

Working the overnight shift (typically 6:00 PM to 4:30 AM or similar) offers distinct lifestyle advantages. Your commute is entirely devoid of rush-hour traffic. The warehouse floor, free from daytime administrative tours, feels more focused and tightly knit. The camaraderie among the night crew is legendary within the company. Most importantly, you are financially rewarded for your hours with substantial "shift differentials" added directly to your base hourly wage.

Core Nightly Objectives

  1. High-Octane Order Processing: Your primary directive is to clear the digital backlog of orders placed during the evening. You will heavily engage in rapid picking and packing operations to ensure all parcels hit the loading dock before the critical dawn dispatch deadlines.
  2. Sortation and Palletizing: You will sort the completed, labeled packages by their final zip codes, meticulously stacking them onto pallets and wrapping them securely for the local delivery stations that dispatch at sunrise.
  3. Facility Reset and Staging: In the final hours of your shift, you will help reset the massive facility. This includes clearing cardboard debris, sweeping aisles, and fully restocking the packing stations with tape, boxes, and dunnage so the incoming day shift can hit the ground running.

Night Shift Rewards and Benefits

The financial perks of the night shift are undeniable, but they come paired with Amazon's legendary corporate benefits. You do not sacrifice quality of life for working nights. You receive the exact same Day 1 healthcare, dental, and vision insurance as daytime employees. You gain immediate access to our 401(k) matching program and the incredible Career Choice tuition coverage. If you are 18+, can lift up to 49 pounds, and thrive in the moonlight, apply today.

Role Based in West Chicago

Role Essentials

  • Job Title: Night Sort Warehouse Associate (Flexible Hours in West Chicago)
  • Location: West Chicago, IL
  • Hiring: UPS
  • This West Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Earnings: $23-$27/Hour (approx. $26.7k/Year)
  • Benefits: Employee discounts and perks (where applicable).
  • Excellent work-life balance in West Chicago.

Responsibilities

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible West Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

While most of the city powers down for the night, UPS powers up. The night sort is the highest-volume, highest-urgency shift in our entire package center operation — the window where the day's accumulated commercial and residential pickups are sorted and loaded onto linehaul trailers that must depart on hard schedules before dawn. If you are a night owl searching for UPS warehouse jobs that pair serious overnight pay differentials with the intensity of a world-class sort operation, our night sort shift is the most financially rewarding entry-level window in our entire logistics careers portfolio.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"The night sort is not for people who want to ease into their shift — it is full speed from the moment the belt starts. But the overnight differential genuinely adds up to a paycheck that beats every comparable warehouse job in this area. I am home by 3 AM, my days are completely free, and the Earn & Learn program is funding my degree while I sleep. UPS night sort is the best-kept secret in the local job market." - Current Night Sort Warehouse Associate, Philadelphia, PA.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Night Sort Warehouse Associate, you process the facility's peak nightly commercial pickup volume during the late-night sort window, working at sustained high intensity to clear the sort floor before hard linehaul trailer departure deadlines inside our package center.

  • High-Volume Commercial Sort Processing: Sort the dense volume of business pickup packages collected by UPS drivers throughout the afternoon, reading destination labels and routing every parcel accurately to its correct outbound trailer lane at peak belt speed.
  • Linehaul Trailer Loading: Load completed outbound pallets and loose packages onto 53-foot linehaul trailers under hard departure window constraints, maximizing trailer cube while maintaining load quality standards that prevent damage during long-distance transport.
  • Departure Deadline Compliance: Work with precise awareness of each trailer's hard departure time, prioritizing the loading sequence to ensure every linehaul trailer is sealed, documented, and released to the yard before its scheduled pull time.

Benefits & Perks

Night Sort Warehouse Associates earn a substantial overnight shift differential on top of the Teamsters base hourly wage — one of the highest total hourly rates available at the entry level across all warehouse jobs in the UPS network. Full Teamsters medical, dental, vision, pension, UPS Earn & Learn tuition funding, and paid personal time are included from day one of eligibility.

jobs.title: Clif Bar Warehouse Team Member (Night Shift 600pm - 600am)
jobs.description:
## Join Us in Leading the Future of Snacking

Are you ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? We’re the team behind iconic brands like Oreo, Ritz, and Chips Ahoy!, and we’re looking for a motivated Warehouse Team Member to join our Indianapolis plant on the night shift.

### What You’ll Do

You’ll play a hands-on role in our warehouse operations, ensuring materials move safely and efficiently from receiving to production to shipping. Your days will be varied and fast-paced. You'll operate stand-up counterbalance forklifts, reach trucks, and powered pallet jacks, and use SAP-EWM or RF systems to manage everything from put-away to replenishment. Supporting the Vongal palletizer and inline wrapper operations will also be part of your routine — you’ll keep material flowing and address minor jams, escalating bigger issues to maintenance.

You’ll also:
- Replenish raw and packaging materials into production areas and dough room kits
- Handle trailer loading and unloading, following strict dock safety controls (wheel chocks, gladhand locks, dock lights)
- Use the pallet inverter to transfer materials between wood, plastic, or CHEP pallets
- Complete all SAP transactions accurately for goods movements, confirming lot codes and quantities

### What Safety & Quality Look Like Here

Safety isn’t just a poster on the wall — it’s how we work. You’ll wear required PPE (safety shoes, hearing protection, high-visibility vest), perform daily pre-use inspections on powered equipment, and tag out any machine that needs service. Every near miss or unsafe condition is reported immediately. Food safety is also critical: you’ll inspect materials for damage or contamination, maintain allergen control, and ensure proper segregation of Good/Hold/Reject items.

### Systems & Inventory Accuracy

You’ll keep our inventory visible and accurate in real time by executing warehouse transactions in SAP-EWM/ECC. Cycle counts, wall-to-wall inventories, and reconciling physical vs. system counts will be part of your routine. If you spot a discrepancy, you’ll escalate it promptly to inventory control or supervision.

### Continuous Improvement & Teamwork

We believe in always getting better. You’ll take part in IL6S, Kaizen, and 5S initiatives that improve safety, quality, and efficiency. You’ll keep your workspace clean, organized, and audit-ready, and you’ll communicate regularly with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Logistics teams. If you have experience to share, you’ll help train new team members by modeling safe, standardized work practices.

### What You’ll Need

**Required:**
- High school diploma or GED
- At least 3 years experience in a warehouse, distribution, or manufacturing environment
- 2+ years operating Powered Industrial Vehicles (PIV), including stand-up counterbalance and stand-up reach forklifts
- Familiarity with SAP-EWM or other WMS, plus RFID use
- Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and work in a food-grade environment
- Strong adaptability to take on diverse responsibilities

**Preferred:**
- Experience with automated palletizing or packaging equipment (Vongal, inline wrappers)
- Prior work in food manufacturing, 3PL, or consumer goods
- Knowledge of IL6S, Lean, or 5S principles

### Work Environment & Schedule

This is a warehouse and production floor setting with variable temperatures, exposed to forklifts, conveyors, palletizers, and moderate noise levels. The night shift runs 6:00pm to 6:00am on a 2-2-3 schedule — you’ll work two days, have two off, then work three, repeating the pattern.

### Compensation & Benefits

The hourly wage for this position is **$23.09/hr**. You’ll also be eligible for an annual incentive program targeting 5% of your salary. Mondelez International offers a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, wellness programs, family support resources, life and disability insurance, a 401K retirement savings plan, paid leave, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time — many of which are subsidized or fully paid by the company.

Mondelez Global LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

  • Benefits: A comprehensive benefits package is included.
  • Stable workload with modern tooling and processes.

What You'll Do

  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Logistics space in East Chicago.

Mastering the Overnight Middle Mile

If the fulfillment center is the brain of the operation, the sortation center is the central nervous system. Welcome to the critical "middle mile" of the Amazon delivery network. As a Night Shift Sortation Warehouse Associate, your primary objective is to group and route thousands of packages during the graveyard hours so they reach the correct local delivery hubs right at dawn. For those seeking highly active, fast-paced night shift warehouse jobs that offer intense teamwork and rapid physical movement, this is the ultimate environment.

The Overnight Sortation Experience

Work in a sort center is fundamentally different from a traditional fulfillment role. You are not picking individual items; you are dealing with sealed, completed packages that are moving rapidly down vast networks of conveyor belts. The atmosphere at night is charged, highly focused, and incredibly team-oriented. When the conveyor belts get heavily loaded during the midnight "rush," you will rely on your night-owl teammates to clear the lines and keep the supply chain moving seamlessly.

  1. Rapid Package Routing: You will read complex digital routing labels as packages fly down the line, pulling them off the belt and sorting them into specific geographical chutes or designated postal carts.
  2. Pallet Architecture: You will become a master of spatial reasoning. Sorting requires building perfectly stable, tightly packed pallets of boxes (often referred to as "playing Tetris" by our veteran associates), which are then heavily shrink-wrapped to prevent transit damage.
  3. Fluid Loading Operations: Utilizing manual pallet jacks, you will safely transport these massive, wrapped pallets directly into the bellies of outbound 18-wheeler semi-trailers, staging them for the early morning over-the-road drivers.

"The night sort center moves incredibly fast, but the overnight shift premium is what keeps me here. Working the graveyard shift allows me to manage my college classes during the day while still getting access to Amazon's incredible 401(k) matching and tuition assistance. The night crew is like a family." - A current Night Sortation Associate.

Flexibility and Night Shift Rewards

We understand that modern life requires flexible schedules. Sortation roles offer some of the most adaptable late-night shifts in the logistics careers landscape, including midnight to morning or late evening options. Associates unlock exceptional health, dental, and vision benefits, along with highly competitive shift differentials that significantly boost your base pay when working non-traditional hours. You will need a strong commitment to workplace safety, the ability to lift up to 49 pounds, and a High School diploma or equivalent to join the night team.

jobs.title: Material Handler Night Shift (7pm-7am)
jobs.description:
Material Handler Night Shift (7pm-7am)

Winpak Portion Packaging is seeking a Material Handler to join the Production Dept based out of our Sauk Village and/or Chicago Heights facilities. In this role you will safely and efficiently service the production lines by supplying or removing materials, in a timely manner, to ensure no downtime is incurred and inventory remains accurate.

Join our Production Department at our Sauk Village facility as a Material Handler. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting production operations by safely and efficiently supplying materials to the production lines and removing finished or excess materials. Your attention to accuracy and timeliness will help ensure continuous production with minimal downtime and maintain precise inventory control. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and is committed to safety, teamwork, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Verify and understand material requirements for assigned jobs.
  • Obtain necessary materials from the warehouse or request them from the remote warehouse as needed.
  • Prepare materials for production (e.g., cleaning, unwrapping, labeling).
  • Safely and promptly deliver materials to machines, ensuring continuous operation and minimizing downtime.
  • Monitor machines and replenish materials as needed to support uninterrupted production.
  • Accurately document material inspections, usage, and assignments in a clear and legible manner.
  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate inventory row tags.
  • Retrieve carts, unused or rejected materials, and other necessary items efficiently.
  • Properly wrap, weigh, label, and store any unused or rejected materials.
  • Keep the work area clean, organized, and safe throughout the shift.
  • Maintain a valid forklift operator certification and operate forklifts safely and efficiently.
  • Complete and document forklift inspections at the start of each shift.
  • Immediately report any safety, material, machine, tooling, quality, or process issues to a supervisor.
  • Manage time effectively to reduce downtime, optimize production, and complete cleaning, inspections, and documentation within the work shift.
  • Comply with all safety policies, procedures, and use of personal protective equipment.
  • Adhere to all personal hygiene and dress code requirements, including appropriate hair coverings.
  • Report any food packaging safety concerns directly to plant management.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.
  • In the event of absence, responsibilities will be delegated to an alternate qualified Material Handler.

Required Qualifications:

  • Follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP): Adhere to all company GMP policies to ensure the safe handling and integrity of food packaging materials.
  • Maintain Sanitation Standards: Support and follow sanitation procedures to uphold cleanliness and reduce contamination risks in all work areas.
  • Quality Assurance Support: Handle and inspect materials in a way that supports the plant\'s quality objectives, preventing mix-ups, contamination, or damage.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Forklift experience.
  • Basic math skills.
  • Basic computer skills.
    • Lifting/carrying up to 50 lbs regularly.
    • Walking/standing approximately 12 hours per day

Additional Information:

  • The Material Handler position is 100% onsite, working on the production floor.
  • 12-Hour COP Shift Rotation:
  • Week 1 - Monday, Tuesday, Friday & Saturday
  • Week 2 - Sunday, Wednesday & Thursday

Compensation range:

The compensation range is $18.20- 25.35 and is provided as a general guideline only. Pay will be determined based on the candidate\'s experience and expertise and is subject to vary.

Why Winpak?

Winpak is committed to providing comprehensive benefits to support the physical, mental, financial and social well-being of our employees and their families. Our benefit package includes the following:

  • Medical, dental, vision & prescription coverage
  • Travel coverage
  • Disability coverage
  • Voluntary life insurance
  • Life and accidental death & dismemberment insurance
  • Tuition assistance program
  • Retirement savings plans
  • A comprehensive employee and family assistance program which includes short term counselling, wellbeing coaching, financial and legal consultations services.

Winpak\'s vision is to provide the best packaging solutions for people and planet. We are a leading supplier of innovative packaging solutions, known for providing high-quality products that meet the needs of a variety of industries, including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and consumer products. With a commitment to sustainability, safety, and excellence, Winpak continues to grow as a global leader in the packaging industry.

At Winpak, inclusion is one of our core values. We believe that an inclusive culture fosters a sense of belonging, drives innovation, and provides our brand a competitive advantage. Our goal is to create an environment free from harassment and discrimination, and where every individual feels respected, valued, and appreciated.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to an equitable and inclusive recruitment process, evaluating applicants based on merit, capability, and qualifications related to the job - never on identity factors such as race, color, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability, national origin, or any other protected status. To support this commitment, if you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to ensure your needs are met.

jobs.title: General Warehouse Laborer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Pay Range:

The amount offered for this position is between $18.00 to $19.38 per hour and may vary depending on the candidate's experience

Rate Frequency:

Hourly

Our teammates are the cornerstone of our organization.

With our company, you'll enjoy outstanding benefits, a competitive salary, opportunities for career advancement, and avenues for personal and professional growth.

Benefits are also granted to Full-time crew members:

  • Paid Training
  • Staff members enjoy a combination of remunerated PTO and public holidays
  • 401(k) Savings with Employer Matching on a 1-to-1 Basis
  • Companies use ESPP as a way to retain employees by offering a unique benefit
  • Medical coverage pays for the costs of medical care, including doctor visits, hospitalization, and prescription drugs
  • Basic and supplemental life insurance plans are designed to provide financial support to the family of the policyholder in the unfortunate event of their death

We offer the necessary tools and resources to help you climb the career ladder and reach new heights of success

Job Overview:

1st Shift

Schedule:

Primarily work Monday to Friday, with opportunities for overtime on weekends or beyond if necessary

Hours:

6:00am-2:30pm

With expertise in using material handling equipment like forklifts and pallet jacks, the General Warehouse Laborer is equipped to move, load, and unload materials throughout the facility and surrounding area.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

Employment opportunities are available to qualified individuals, without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Description:

Pay Range:

The salary for this position varies based on experience, with an hourly rate of $18.00 to $22.70 on offer

Rate Frequency:

Hourly

Schedule:

The designated business days for our company are between Monday and Thursday, where we are available for service from 3:30pm until 2:00am

What sets us apart is the exceptional quality of our staff.

As a member of our organization, you'll enjoy a broad range of incentives, remuneration that is on par with industry standards, chances for professional growth, and opportunities for advancement. Our full-time collaborators, in particular, are eligible for:

  • Paid Training
  • The privilege of having both paid holidays and Paid Time Off
  • A 401(k) program in which the company matches employee contributions on a dollar-for-dollar basis
  • The Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) typically has a set enrollment period during which employees can elect to participate in the program
  • With group health insurance, employees can enjoy the benefits of affordable and reliable healthcare coverage, including preventative care, emergency services, and hospitalization
  • Understanding Basic Life Insurance

Elevate your career with our innovative training programs

Job Overview:

The Seasonal Automated Warehouse Package Handler is responsible for completing customer orders. They do so by taking necessary items and quantities as mentioned on a pick ticket or a computer screen. Upon taking these items, they place them on a designated conveyor or pallet. Their performance must meet the company's regulations with due consideration for safety, accuracy, and efficiency.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Assisting in the selection and handling of items in an automated environment involves using sophisticated machinery, software applications, and computers while following CCCI's established safety policies and procedures. Your multi-tasking skills, coupled with a quick decision-making ability, are invaluable in such a noisy and demanding environment.
  • Facilitates reliable warehouse procedures through team collaboration.
  • Exhibits versatility in adjusting to the requirements of the role by staying informed about the different work sections within the facility and satisfying the minimum performance criteria of each section, including but not limited to, HQS, Semi-Automated Lanes, Flow Rack, and Pallet Pick.
  • Ensuring that the warehouse functions without complications, you will assist in maintaining a hygienic environment by keeping your workstation free from refuse and clutter, mopping up any drips or spills that occur, and following the waste management and recycling practices as required.
  • Adheres to secure, accurate, and proficient protocols to regulate warehouse inventory and prevent shrinkage from exceeding acceptable levels.
  • To keep a warehouse running efficiently in a constantly changing environment, performs miscellaneous tasks as assigned.

Knowledge refers to the information and understanding that one has about a particular subject or domain, while skills are practical abilities that are developed through practice and experience, and abilities are innate talents or qualities that one possesses

  • Possessing the capability to perform in a swift atmosphere while walking and recurrently hoisting 30 lbs.
  • Aptitude to handle items weighing up to 75 pounds.
  • The aptitude to team up with others in a collaborative surrounding is a valuable ability.
  • Capable of streamlining and systematizing warehouse operations to promote efficiency and dependability.
  • The flexibility to adapt to the needs of different work domains and fulfill the minimum requirements of each area.
  • The aptitude to read and understand instructions shown on a computer display.
  • The capability to be meticulous and to distinguish our packages is of great importance.
  • Proficiency to work in an environment that lacks temperature control with high levels of noise.
  • Someone who is self-directed and continuously looks for ways to add value without being prompted.
  • A work environment that can adjust to meet the changing demands of the industry is referred to as flexibility.
  • The use of screens, monitors, and devices is a crucial aspect of performing accurate picking while adhering to a specific order.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • The experience gathered within the first three years of work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Having a high school diploma or GED signals to employers that an individual has acquired basic knowledge, skills, and competencies.

Work Environment:

  • This location presents challenges for workers, as it lacks proper temperature control and experiences high levels of noise.

Our company takes pride in being an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer, which means that we treat all candidates fairly and equally, regardless of their background, gender, ethnicity, or religion.

Cleveland

jobs.description:
We have great opportunity for those seeking a new challenge, but also a fantastic place to work. Come grow with us!

SPS offers a competitive benefits package including paid time off, paid holidays, medical, dental, vision, legal and life insurance, transit program, referral bonuses, pet discounts, EAP, and a 401K with company match.

Schedule: Typically Monday - Friday, 7:30AM-4:30PM/8AM-5PM (Flexes based on area assisting with)

What You Will Be Doing

  • Giving amazing customer service to our onsite operation by scanning/delivering/tracking/reporting in and outgoing business packages and mail (via UPS, USPS, Fedex, etc).
  • Assisting the onsite personnel in retrieving their packages and providing records management in person, by email, by phone, or similar methods.
  • Oversee the onsite business center, which may include: office supply stocking, assisting with copy/print orders, conference room setup up, pantry inventory, or light facilities.
  • Serves as backup to route driving roles, which provide delivery to onsite personnel for packages, pallets, etc.

What We Need From You

  • 3+ year experience in shipping & receiving, mailroom, route driving, or similar services.
  • Valid U.S. Driver's License, must be at least 25 years old to meet our standards to company car insurance, and have had license for at least 5 years.
  • A positive and professional attitude with a willingness to go above and beyond for our customers.
  • Previous material handling skills a plus, including ability to use motorized and manual equipment such as forklifts (in locations where they are needed), pallet jacks, and hand trucks.
  • Ability to perform the following types of physical activities: lift up to 50 pounds, push/pull to move equipment, bend/stoop/squat/kneel, and reach above shoulders
  • Background and experience working in a warehouse or loading dock environment, with exposure to varied weather conditions a plus.
  • Must be willing to be cross-trained to support all tasks required for that site, including, but not limited to: routes, receiving, mail services, shipping, floaters, freight coordination & logistics, loading dock operations, and customer service/help desk. Must be experienced with and able to troubleshoot issues regarding tracking software, secure lockers, and other tools & technology used by the SRM team. Must remain flexible and ready to support the needs of the business. In some field offices, Supervisors will collaborate with cross functional partners to support waste, secure waste, and eWaste programs.

Compensation

The expected compensation is an estimate, and the final offer will depend on skills, experience, location, and other job-related factors.

Vacancy Status

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Pay Range

$21 - $21 USD

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: An opportunity to enter a job that allows you to learn new skills or use a variety of them that may lead you to uncover other career opportunities.
  • Learning & Development: At SPS, we promote a work culture of learning so that you can develop to be the best at what you do.
  • We Recognize Talent: We offer a variety of recognition programs for all levels of employees.
  • Paid Time Off: Full time: Minimum of 80 hours/calendar year. Part time/temporary: Minimum of 1 hour for every 30 hours worked. PTO amounts may increase based on tenure and/or the assigned account. PTO allows employees to take approved time off for any reason.
  • Bonuses: Are available for employee and client referrals for current employees.
  • Benefit Offerings: Medical, Dental, Vision, HCFSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter Transit and Parking Pre-Tax Plans, Supplemental Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Program, Identify Theft Protection, Pet Discounts, Pet Insurance, Group Home and Auto Insurance, EAP, Short Term Disability, Life Insurance, Education Discounts, 401k w/ matching, and Entertainment Discounts.

SPS is a global workplace solutions and business transformation company operating in more than 20 countries. Across North America, we help clients enhance workplace experiences and business operations through services including workplace support, physical and digital mailroom solutions, intelligent document processing, reception and concierge services, and other business support offerings.

Our clients include leading organizations across banking, insurance, legal, higher education, professional services, and many Fortune 500 companies.

Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

Warehouse Associates are accountable for accurately performing a combination of manual and automated tasks necessary for receipt, storage, transporting, picking, packing, shipping, staging, delivery etc. of product that may be hazardous, temperature sensitive, or of high value amid continuously demonstrating behaviors aligned with Abbvie’s attributes and values.

Responsibilities

  • Comply with all appropriate policies and procedures to successfully maintain training, safety, GxP, and governmental agency standards.
  • Ability to comprehend and accurately process paperwork in accordance with policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
  • Responsible for cross-training in multiple areas of the operation while maintaining a low level of quality mistakes.
  • Accurately receive and inspect inbound product/material for infestation, overages, shortages, and damages (OS&D).
  • Efficiently and correctly pick customer orders for shipment, ensuring that the correct number and type of product is picked.
  • Transfers and locates material/product to general storage areas or shipping locations.
  • Verify quantity, quality, labeling and address with the customer’s order to ensure outgoing shipments are complete and accurate.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED to ensure ability to accurately complete basic math calculations, read and understand training documents, product labeling and warehouse signage written in English.
  • Pass medical screening and background checks that may be conducted by local, state, and/or federal authorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to fast changing work demand.
  • Self-motivated with ability to work in a fast-paced positive team-oriented environment, coupled with good multi-tasking skills.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft office products, general computer skills and RF scanners. Ability to comprehend and execute standard problem-solving skills and effectively communicate verbally and written.
  • Capable of lifting 50 lbs., and/or more with assistance. Able to bend, reach, stoop, climb, stand and walk for entire shift of 8 hours or more.
  • Operate various types of material handling equipment including but not limited to forklifts, hand tools and other devices operated in a warehouse environment while maintaining the highest level of productivity and accuracy.
  • Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to complete assigned tasks.
  • Ability to work in an atmosphere range of 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F).

At Graphic Packaging International, we produce the paper cup that held your coffee this morning, the basket that transported those bottles of craft beer you enjoyed last weekend, and the microwave tray that heated your gourmet meal last night. A World of Difference. Made Possible.

OPPORTUNITY: We are a Food service folding carton manufacturing operation seeking candidates to join our Chicago IL team. We’re recruiting for multiple positions so be sure you review all of our job postings. This job posting is for a Shipping – Receiving associate with a pay range of $21.91 to $25.36 /hour plus shift differential and progressive pay increases. We continually encourage our employees to advance their careers through on the job training and job progression through our strong promotion from within program. We offer a wide array of benefits including, but not limited to, Paid Vacation & Holidays, optional Health, Dental, and Life Insurance, including health spending accounts and a progressive healthy lifestyle program, as well as 401-K with a company matching component and standard supplemental company contributions. JOB SUMMARY: The person who occupies this position is responsible for shipping, receiving coordinating traffic, warehousing inventories, communications and producing product and any other items as they relate to shipping out of or being received into the plant and warehouse locations.

JOB FUNCTIONS: Job functions include, but are not limited to the following.

A shipping material handler will spend approximately 70% of working shift on a forklift and 30% doing other shipping duties.

  • Maintain a safe and clean environment inside and outside of the facility.

  • Record shipping data such as damages, rejected trailers, discrepancies for reporting, accounting and recordkeeping purposes.
  • Determine shipping methods and procedures for safe shipment based on the material using shipping knowledge and procedures.
  • Deliver or rout incoming material or equipment to the appropriate departments.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment
jobs.description:
Warehouse Associate – Picking, Packing & Fulfillment

Alice & Wonder | Chicago, IL 60642
Starting at $17.50/hour

About the Role

Alice & Wonder is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented Warehouse Associate to join our Chicago warehouse team.

This position is primarily responsible for picking, packing, tagging, and preparing merchandise for our retail stores and online customers.

We're looking for someone who works efficiently, pays attention to the little details, and enjoys being part of a fast-moving team. You'll spend your day working with our products—picking merchandise, tagging clothing, preparing store transfers, packing online orders, checking product quality, and making sure orders leave our warehouse accurately and looking great.

Accuracy and productivity are the two biggest priorities in this role.

What You'll Do

Picking, Packing & Store Fulfillment

  • Pick merchandise accurately for store transfers and customer orders
  • Scan, pack, and prepare inventory transfers for our retail locations
  • Verify styles, sizes, colors, and quantities before orders are completed
  • Keep orders organized throughout the fulfillment process
  • Help ensure stores receive the right merchandise on time

Online Order Fulfillment

  • Pick and pack online customer orders accurately and efficiently
  • Inspect merchandise before packing to ensure it meets our quality standards
  • Prepare packages for shipment
  • Make sure orders are neat, accurate, and presentation-ready
  • Gift-wrap customer orders when requested

Tagging & Product Preparation

  • Tag and label clothing, accessories, and other incoming merchandise
  • Prepare new merchandise so it is ready for our stores and customers
  • Organize product by style, size, or designated inventory location
  • Identify damaged, defective, or incorrect merchandise
  • Communicate product or inventory discrepancies to the Warehouse Lead

Warehouse Support

  • Help count and verify incoming merchandise
  • Assist with inventory counts as needed
  • Restock and organize picking and packing areas
  • Keep your workstation and surrounding warehouse areas clean and organized
  • Work closely with warehouse, shipping, retail, and other teams
  • Pitch in with other warehouse tasks when needed

What We're Looking For

You could be a great fit if you:

  • Are dependable and consistently show up on time
  • Have strong attention to detail
  • Can work quickly without sacrificing accuracy
  • Are organized and like keeping things in the right place
  • Are comfortable working on your feet throughout your shift
  • Can follow established processes and instructions
  • Work well independently and as part of a team
  • Are comfortable doing repetitive tasks such as picking, packing, folding, tagging, and labeling merchandise
  • Take pride in sending out an accurate, well-presented order
  • Bring a positive attitude and are willing to help wherever needed

Previous retail, warehouse, inventory, stockroom, picking/packing, or fulfillment experience is helpful, but not required. We're happy to train the right person who is dependable, motivated, and willing to learn.

Physical Requirements

This is an active warehouse position that requires standing and moving throughout the workday.

The position regularly requires:

  • Standing and walking for extended periods
  • Bending, reaching, and moving around warehouse work areas
  • Picking merchandise from inventory locations
  • Packing, folding, tagging, and handling merchandise throughout the day
  • Lifting and carrying boxes weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation

What Success Looks Like

Get the orders right and get them done.

Our stores receive the correct merchandise. Online customers receive the correct orders. Clothing gets tagged properly. Product is checked before it leaves the warehouse. Orders are completed efficiently, accurately, and on time.

You're someone the team can depend on to consistently get the details right.

About Alice & Wonder

Alice & Wonder is a Chicago-based retail company offering fun, unique, and affordable apparel, accessories, gifts, and more.

We're a growing local business with a hardworking, team-oriented environment. We move quickly, help each other out, and believe you can get a lot done while still having fun at work.

We're looking for people who want to be part of the team and contribute to what we're building.

What We Offer

  • Paid time off
  • Paid sick time
  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Fun, energetic work atmosphere
  • Team-oriented environment
  • Opportunity to learn different parts of a growing retail business
  • Employee growth opportunities

If you're organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and enjoy getting things done, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: From $17.50 per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Flexible schedule
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

  • Are you able to stand and move throughout an 8-hour shift and lift/carry items weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation?
  • Are you comfortable performing repetitive warehouse tasks such as picking orders, packing boxes, tagging clothing, folding merchandise, and preparing store transfers throughout your shift?
  • How many years of experience do you have in warehouse, retail stockroom, inventory, picking/packing, or order fulfillment?
  • Tell us about a job, school, or other experience where accuracy and attention to detail were important. What did you do to make sure your work was correct?

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant 2 - Seasonal
jobs.description:
Position Overview | The Big Picture

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for moving, storing, covering, and preparing props and furniture for warehouse storage or into bins for delivery. The Warehouse Assistant reports to the Warehouse Manager and may take direction from the Warehouse Assistant Manager and Warehouse Lead.


Our Mission Values | Our Commitments

Each employee works together to strive to create the best design company by improving communication, showing genuine care for each other and the company, focusing on delivering quality, and demonstrating professionalism through personal excellence, with a shared passion, dedication, and commitment to providing exceptional value to our clients.

Traits for Success | #hardworker
  • Safety-minded
  • Team player.
  • Great Listener.
  • Steady worker.
  • Good with hands.


Essential Duties | What You’ll Do – The Fun Stuff

  • Learns inventory and pull sheets to successfully fill event orders.
  • Prepares props and furniture for events to include but not limited to: wrapping fabric and vinyl, drilling holes, nailing, hammering, hand and spray painting, polishing, cleaning and staining.
  • Wraps furniture and props for delivery; unwraps inventory as needed.
  • Cleans and sweeps work space to ensure workspace is organized, safe and free from obstacles and debris.
  • Warehouse Assistant levels 2 and 3 perform increasingly more complex and detailed prop and warehouse work and require less supervision.

Other Duties and Safety Requirements | There’s More!
  • Complies with all department and company safety guidelines, procedures, and rules.
  • Mentors safe work practices to co-workers and team.
  • Completes all safety training as directed and within established timelines.
  • Interfaces professionally with all people, internal and external, in a kind and respectful manner.
  • Tracks and enters time and assigns hours and tasks to appropriate events and jobs in time and attendance system.
  • Completes all Human Resources and Payroll tasks and notifications through the Employee Self Service Online Portal on a weekly basis, as directed and within established timelines.
  • Assists in other departments as needed and directed.
  • May perform other duties as required.

Qualifications | What You Need to Bring
  • Ability to understand, read and speak simple English.
  • Good verbal communication skills to communicate successfully with the Warehouse team.
  • Ability to interpret pull sheets.
  • Familiarity with proper packing methods is helpful.
  • Must be able to provide the following tools for use during the work shift: wire cutter and utility knife.
  • Good knowledge and ability to use tools and equipment that may include: hammer, screwdriver, hand drill, tape measure, dollies, and 8 foot and 12 foot ladders.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules to include evenings and weekends.

Physical and Work Environment Requirements | What it is Like in the Shop
  • Ability to stand, kneel, crouch, bend and reach during entire work shift.
  • Able to walk 30% of the work shift.
  • Ability to work with hands and arms during entire shift.
  • Must be able to move and climb ladders without accommodation.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push and pull 30-40 lbs. throughout the shift. Occasionally may move up to and over 100 lbs. with assistance.
  • Ability to handle fragile items safely.
  • Must have 20/20 vision with correction.
  • Must be able to tolerate cold, heat and humid conditions.
  • May be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, and chemicals throughout the work shift.
  • Ability to tolerate moderate noise.


Pay & Benefits | What You’ll Receive

  • Hourly wage: $18.00 to $22.00 based on experience.
  • Overtime pay will be provided for hours worked beyond 40 in a workweek at 1.5x the regular rate of pay, in compliance with Illinois labor laws.
  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options available full-time.
  • Retirement Plan: 401(k) plan with company matching.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): In compliance with Illinois State Law.
  • Training & Development: Opportunities for skill development and career advancement.

Other Benefits

  • Flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend availability.
  • Safe and supportive work environment.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:
Kehoe Designs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
Yard & Warehouse Laborer – Tire Recycling

K&S Tire Recycling is hiring dependable, hardworking individuals to join our yard and warehouse team in Chicago Heights, IL.

This is a hands-on, physically demanding position for someone who is comfortable working in an industrial environment and wants steady work with an established, growing company.

What You’ll Do

As a Yard & Warehouse Laborer, you will help keep tires and other recyclable materials moving safely and efficiently throughout our facility.

Daily Responsibilities Include

  • Load and unload tires from trucks, trailers, and containers
  • Move tires by hand and with hand trucks/dollies
  • Sort, stack, organize, and stage tires
  • Grade and inspect used tires based on condition and quality
  • Move and sort other scrap and recyclable materials
  • Maintain organized tire and material storage areas
  • Assist with general warehouse and yard operations
  • Perform general cleanup and housekeeping throughout the facility
  • Work safely around forklifts, loaders, trucks, conveyors, and other moving industrial machinery
  • Follow company safety procedures and supervisor instructions
  • Perform other general labor duties as needed

Requirements

Physical Requirements

This is an active, physical job. Applicants must be able to:

  • Regularly lift, carry, push, and move materials weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Handle and move tires repeatedly throughout the workday
  • Stand, walk, bend, reach, push, pull, and lift for extended periods
  • Work both indoors and outdoors
  • Work in varying temperatures and weather conditions
  • Work safely in an active industrial environment around moving vehicles and machinery

  • Are dependable and show up to work on time
  • Are willing and able to perform physical labor throughout the shift
  • Have a strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Can follow directions and safety procedures
  • Work well as part of a team
  • Take pride in keeping their work area clean and organized
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-paced industrial environment

Minimum 1 year warehouse, tire, recycling, automotive, construction, landscaping, manufacturing, or general labor experience is required.

Why Work With K&S Tire Recycling?

K&S Tire Recycling is a growing tire recycling company serving customers throughout the Midwest. Our operation keeps millions of pounds of tires and recyclable materials out of landfills and puts those materials back to productive use.

We value employees who are reliable, safety-conscious, hardworking, and willing to learn.

We offer accrued sick/vacation time.

We have 1st and 2nd shift positions available.

jobs.description:
Description

Ready for more than just a job? Build a career with purpose.

At Lactalis in the USA, we’re committed to providing meaningful opportunities for our people to learn, grow, and thrive—whether you’re just starting your journey with us or looking to take the next step in your career. From day one, we offer the tools and support to help you succeed.

As the world leader in dairy, Lactalis is a family-owned company with over 85,000 pragmatic and ambitious professionals across the globe. Each day, we’re proud to produce award-winning dairy products that bring people together.

In the US, we proudly offer an unrivaled house of beloved brands, including Galbani® Italian cheeses and ricotta, Président® specialty cheeses and butters, Kraft® natural and grated cheeses, Breakstone’s® cottage cheese, Cracker Barrel®, Black Diamond® cheddar, and Parmalat® milk. Our yogurt portfolio includes siggi’s®, Stonyfield Organic®, Brown Cow™, Oui®, Yoplait®, Go-Gurt®, :ratio®, Green Mountain Creamery®, and Mountain High®, along with a growing family of ethnic favorites like Karoun®, Gopi®, and Arz®.

At Lactalis, we live by our core values—Ambition, Engagement, and Simplicity. We foster a workplace where innovation thrives, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone’s unique background and ideas are valued.

Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We want to hear about your PASSION, your STORY, and how your EXPERTISE can help us shape the future of dairy.

From your PASSION to ours

Lactalis USA, part of the Lactalis family of companies, is currently hiring a Sr. Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems based in Chicago, IL. As a Sr Analyst, Warehouse Management Systems, the role will carry out responsibilities such as supporting technical solution design, configuration support, integrations, enhancements, testing, deployment, and production support for Blue Yonder WM and related SAP-enabled Supply Chain Execution processes. The role includes working on Functional, technical specifications, interfaces, APIs, data mapping, reporting, troubleshooting, and integration with SAP Inventory Management, Materials Management, Sales/Distribution, Transportation, and Manufacturing processes. Additionally, the Technical Analyst will collaborate with functional analysts, business stakeholders, IT integration teams, and external partners to deliver stable, scalable solutions aligned with company goals and values.

Requirements

From your EXPERTISE to ours

Key Responsibilities For This Position Include

  • Strong hands-on Blue Yonder WM technical experience primarily in “Warehouse Management and Supply Chain Execution” processes.
  • Experience in integrating ERP/Host systems with Blue Yonder’s Warehouse Management Systems
  • Partner with functional analysts and business users to understand requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications and solution designs.
  • Develop, support, and troubleshoot technical objects such as interfaces, reports, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, integrations, and data extracts related to Blue Yonder WM.
  • Support system integrations between Blue Yonder WM to SAP ECC, middleware(Go Anywhere), EDI, APIs transportation, manufacturing, and third-party logistics applications.
  • Analyze BY interface failures, application errors, data mapping issues, transaction processing defects, and performance bottlenecks; document root cause and corrective actions.
  • Support API usage, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting for inbound, outbound, and internal warehouse processes.
  • Participate in system configuration reviews, technical impact assessments, design walkthroughs, unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities.
  • Prepare and maintain technical design documents, interface mapping documents, test evidence, cutover tasks, deployment checklists, and production support knowledge articles.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional IT teams, business process owners, and project teams to resolve integration and application issues.
  • Support large-scale BY WMS implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and legacy WMS replacement initiatives.
  • Ensure technical solutions follow IT standards for documentation, controls, security, scalability, maintainability, and operational support.
  • Provide hypercare and production support for Blue Yonder WM incidents, enhancement requests, and operational issues.
  • Comfortable working alongside business analysts and functional teams who provide requirements.
  • Experience with using / Testing APIs.
  • Experience in working with Native SaaS WMS solutions.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience working within Blue Yoder’s Warehouse Management Systems either as a customer of Blue Yonder or as a consultant implementing Blue Yonder solutions for customers.
  • Additionally relevant solutions consulting and implementation experience with other leading supply chain planning solutions such as SAP WM, Infolog is a plus.

From your STORY to ours

Qualified Applicants Will Contribute The Following

  • Bachelor's degree is required in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Management, Supply Chain Management, Logistics / Operations Management, or related field.
  • Preferred Blue Yonder WMS Technical Accreditation/certified.
  • 3+ years Strong Technical Experience in Blue Yonder Warehouse Management System is required.
  • Hands-on BY Warehouse Management process and integration with SAP ECC System (application and configuration) for global project implementations; food industry experience preferred.
  • Ensure Warehouse Process business requirements across Supply Chain Area and related functions are translated into detailed functional specifications.
  • Configure and test system processes; troubleshoot, document, and resolve system-related issues.

Certifications and specific knowledge

  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder Warehouse Management Processes is required.
  • Knowledge of Blue Yonder WM inbound, outbound, internal warehouse process and integration with transportation, manufacturing and SAP ECC system is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points and techniques with SAP system and logistics, as well as 3rd party applications is required.
  • Knowledge of integration points with SAP modules such as Invenorty Management, Procurement, Sales and Transportation planning are required.

At Lactalis, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards Program with a variety of affordable benefits and coverage options. We support insurance costs significantly, contribute generously to retirement plans, and offer Paid Time Off from day one. We are committed to your professional growth, providing training and development opportunities, including Education Reimbursement. Join us and grow your career.

Lactalis is an equal employment opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against applicants with regard to any legally-recognized basis including, but not limited to: veteran status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, sexual orientation, and physical or mental disabilities. Further, any division of the Company that is an Affirmative Action Employer will comply with all related legal obligations.

jobs.title: Warehouse Associate (Trade Shows & Events)
jobs.description:
Experience Without Limits
Come shape the future of brand experience.

At Jack Morton, we design and build head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients unlock the full value of experiences by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.

That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one. We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.

This is a place where curiosity drives what's next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.

Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.

**Must be able to work onsite 5 days/week in Addison, IL**

Love bringing big experiences to life behind the scenes? Join our team and help power the trade shows, live events, and brand activations seen across the country.

We're looking for a Warehouse Associate/Asset Technician to support our Addison, Illinois operations team in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. This role is ideal for someone who takes pride in organization, accuracy, and teamwork—and enjoys seeing their work come to life on the show floor.

What You'll Do

  • Support day-to-day warehouse operations including receiving, staging, shipping, and logistics coordination
  • Operate forklifts daily to move, organize, and prepare event materials and client assets
  • Pull and stage components for trade show booths, custom exhibits, and hybrid builds
  • Read and interpret CAD drawings and pull lists to ensure project accuracy
  • Maintain show-ready condition of all event assets and materials
  • Conduct inventory checks and track materials using inventory management systems
  • Identify damaged or missing assets and communicate refurbishment or repair needs
  • Keep the warehouse clean, organized, safe, and client-tour ready
  • Work both independently and collaboratively to meet production schedules and deadlines

What You Bring

  • 6–12 months of warehouse, logistics, production, or operational experience (or equivalent training)
  • Forklift experience and comfort working in an active warehouse environment
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow pull lists accurately
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong accountability
  • Strong communication skills and team-oriented attitude
  • Basic computer proficiency including Excel and Outlook
  • Ability to regularly lift and move up to 50 lbs

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a team that helps deliver high-profile events and brand experiences
  • Work in a collaborative, energetic environment where every day is different
  • Gain hands-on exposure to the growing world of trade shows and experiential marketing
  • Join a company where your contributions directly impact successful event execution.

If you have provided personal information in connection with a fake job offer or interview and you are concerned, we suggest that you take appropriate action.

jobs.title: Shipping & Receiving Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As a Fortune 50 company with over 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and a leader in American retail. Working at Target provides the opportunity to help families experience the joy of everyday life. We are deeply committed to supporting our communities, investing in the places we live, work, and play. Our team values relationships, fosters talent growth, and thrives together as one. At our core, we prioritize care, growth, and success together.

Roles and Duties:

  • Uphold all safety regulations and procedures to ensure workplace security.
  • Attendance in safety training seminars is crucial for mastering the techniques required for working efficiently in a busy warehouse environment.
  • Wrap, transport, and send merchandise to customers and retail establishments.
  • Ensure the meticulous handling of goods for store shipment and guest drop-offs.
  • Facilitate the movement of freight and optimize inventory operations within the warehouse.
  • Ensure your workspace is clean, well-maintained, and devoid of clutter.
  • Arrive promptly for work and ensure that tasks are finished with precision and within the set timeframe.
  • Take part in problem-solving efforts to facilitate continual operational advancements.
  • Exhibit a favorable and considerate behavior when working autonomously or in a team environment.

Requirements:

  • Able to routinely carry and transport items with weights falling within the range of 35-50 lbs.
  • Able to occasionally lift and carry items up to 60 lbs.
  • Physical ability for standing, walking, pushing, pulling, squatting, bending, and reaching during assigned periods.
  • Keep a proactive and capable attitude while engaged in group work or working autonomously.
  • Fundamental numerical operations, such as counting, addition, and subtraction.
  • Skill in accurately interpreting and understanding labels, tickets, and other product documentation.
  • Operate computer systems or handheld devices independently and effectively once adequately trained.
  • Demonstrating adeptness in spoken and written interactions.
  • Capability in comprehending, speaking, and reading English to adhere to safety guidelines, policies, and directions.

Additional Requirements:

  • Competent in undergoing instruction and using motorized machinery securely (such as Pallet Rider, Scissor Lift, Sit-Down & Stand-Up Forklift).
  • Capable of working comfortably at heights reaching up to 40 feet if needed.
  • Proficient in conducting duties for prolonged periods within environments that are temperature-controlled, like refrigerators and freezers.

Benefits:

Target team members may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, subject to plan terms and employment eligibility. Employees also receive a 10% Target discount, plus an extra 20% off select wellness products, including fruits, vegetables, healthy foods, activewear, and tobacco cessation products.

Note:

Based on business needs and role requirements within Warehouse Operations, candidates may be considered for either a Warehouse Worker or Warehouse Associate position. The specific job responsibilities for each role are outlined in the application process.

Opportunity in Chicago

Fast Facts

  • Part-Time Opportunity in Chicago: Receiving Associate
  • Based in: Chicago, IL
  • Company: FedEx Supply Chain
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our FedEx Supply Chain team in Chicago, IL is growing.

What You Get

  • Pay Rate: $17-$22/Hour (approx. $20.5k/Year)
  • Benefits: Weekly pay options may be available.
  • Perfect for students or those seeking supplemental income.

Day-to-Day

  • This role focuses on your professional skills with a schedule that fits your life.

About FedEx Supply Chain Inbound Receiving

Receiving Associates are the first hands that touch inventory when it arrives at a FedEx Supply Chain distribution center. Every pallet, carton, and loose item that flows into the facility must be verified against purchase orders, inspected for damage, scanned into the warehouse management system, and staged for put-away — all with zero tolerance for quantity errors that would cascade into picking inaccuracies and customer order failures downstream. Receiving is where inventory accuracy begins.

Position Overview

FedEx Supply Chain is hiring Receiving Associates to process inbound vendor shipments at distribution center facilities. You will unload inbound trailers, verify freight against purchase orders and advance ship notices, scan items into the WMS, and stage received inventory for forklift put-away. This is a daytime dock-side position critical to maintaining downstream inventory accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Unload inbound vendor trailers using pallet jacks, transferring palletized and loose freight to the receiving staging area.
  • Verify received quantities and SKUs against purchase orders, flagging overages, shortages, and damaged items immediately.
  • Scan all received inventory into the warehouse management system, generating put-away tasks for forklift operators.
  • Inspect inbound freight for visible damage, documenting exceptions with photographs and carrier damage reports.
  • Stage verified pallets in designated put-away lanes organized by storage zone for efficient forklift processing.

Qualifications & Benefits

Must be 18+ years of age. No prior receiving or warehouse experience required — full training provided. Strong counting accuracy and attention to detail essential. Must lift up to 50 lbs and work at dock-side receiving areas. FedEx Supply Chain offers competitive receiving associate pay, daytime shift schedules, weekly paychecks, full medical/dental/vision, 401(k) matching, tuition assistance, and advancement into inventory control and lead positions.

The Delivery & Warehouse Associate is responsible for conducting pickups and making deliveries within prescribed deadlines, receiving and accurately inventorying inbound deliveries, maintaining accurate inventories of client wines, assisting clients when they visit their storage locker, and representing the UOVO Wine brand. In addition, manage the cleanliness and organization of the warehouse, participate in daily warehouse projects, actively engage as a member of the Operations Team, and perform other duties as assigned.



Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Very good interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Very good analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Strong time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Very good verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to keep client account information confidential



Preferred Skills/Abilities:

  • Experience dealing with wine products
  • Experience with a forklift
  • Experience driving a cargo van or larger commercial vehicle
  • Experience with a pallet jack
  • Experience with a hand truck
  • Experience with shipping and logistics
  • Experience with computers, especially with Microsoft Office 365
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate



Responsibilities:

  • Conduct local pickup and deliveries as needed
  • Perform offsite activities in client cellars, outside locations and other storage facilities
  • Timely inventory inbounds accurately into the correct database on a daily basis
  • Put together shipping cases as needed
  • Move, organize, build and breakdown shipping pallets as needed
  • Consolidate inventories as needed
  • Inventory client's wines as requested or required
  • Conduct inventory audits to resolve discrepancies as needed
  • Conduct pick and pull requests and prepare wines/cases for pickup or shipping as needed
  • Keep the warehouse organized and cleaned on a daily basis
  • Ensure the security of the property before departure on a daily basis
  • Function and participate as a Team member in meetings and special projects
  • Perform other related duties as assigned



Physical Requirements:

  • Working in a 55-degree F warehouse; exposure to extreme heat and cold when making deliveries throughout the year
  • Sitting, standing, walking, pulling, pushing and climbing stairs/ladders throughout the shift
  • Requires finger and wrist manipulation and/or grasping more than 50% of the time
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds at times



Travel Requirements:

  • Local pickups or deliveries, some of which require overnight trips out of state



Education, Experience and/or Certifications:


Required:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
  • Be able to pass the Federal DOT physical and obtain a Federal DOT driver's license (if applicable)
  • 1 - 3 years of warehouse experience
  • 1 - 3 years of delivery and driving experience



Preferred:

  • Forklift certification

Salary commensurate with experience. This position includes generous paid time off; health, dental, vision, STD and LTD insurance; 401(K) with 4.5% match; $1000 education stipend; $250 charitable donation; wine education; entrepreneurial work atmosphere with opportunity for strong performers to advance quickly.

jobs.title: General Warehouse Laborer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Pay Range:

The amount offered for this position is between $18.00 to $19.38 per hour and may vary depending on the candidate's experience

Rate Frequency:

Hourly

Our teammates are the cornerstone of our organization.

With our company, you'll enjoy outstanding benefits, a competitive salary, opportunities for career advancement, and avenues for personal and professional growth.

Benefits are also granted to Full-time crew members:

  • Paid Training
  • Staff members enjoy a combination of remunerated PTO and public holidays
  • 401(k) Savings with Employer Matching on a 1-to-1 Basis
  • Companies use ESPP as a way to retain employees by offering a unique benefit
  • Medical coverage pays for the costs of medical care, including doctor visits, hospitalization, and prescription drugs
  • Basic and supplemental life insurance plans are designed to provide financial support to the family of the policyholder in the unfortunate event of their death

We offer the necessary tools and resources to help you climb the career ladder and reach new heights of success

Job Overview:

1st Shift

Schedule:

Primarily work Monday to Friday, with opportunities for overtime on weekends or beyond if necessary

Hours:

6:00am-2:30pm

With expertise in using material handling equipment like forklifts and pallet jacks, the General Warehouse Laborer is equipped to move, load, and unload materials throughout the facility and surrounding area.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Select vending and cold drink equipment that can effectively serve the sales requests.
  • It's crucial to utilize protective wrapping and attach the proper documentation (STO) to guarantee the safety and security of all outbound loads.
  • Follow CCCI's SOPs when aiding in the loading and unloading of trailers to assist with delivery operations. Use handhelds to update SAP and CONA, keeping track of inbound and outbound loads to ensure accuracy and accountability for the territories served by the Regional Operation Center.
  • Emphasize safety and cleanliness by completing all necessary pre- and post-trip evaluations, double-checking daily documentation for accuracy, and ensuring a tidy and obstacle-free work area.
  • Participate in various duties as directed, such as staging equipment and managing yard work, such as removing clutter and maintaining a neat appearance.
  • Use a switching system to move pup and 53' trailers to the docking location as needed.

There are certain traits that individuals must possess in order to be successful in their professional role. These traits are often referred to as knowledge, skills, and abilities, or KSAs

  • Proficient understanding of essential safety principles, including proper lifting methods and the adoption of personal safety clothing.
  • Possess expert-level forklift skills required to operate single-wide forklifts with finesse and accuracy.
  • Basic pallet-jack skills.
  • Elementary competence in mechanics and uncomplicated employment of tools.
  • Knowledgeable in handling different rudimentary machines.
  • Following written guidelines or instructions is essential for best practices.
  • Generate reports through handwritten or computer-based formats to track progress.
  • Follow verbal instructions.
  • Intermediate math skills.
  • A holistic understanding of the aspects that bolster productivity.
  • The ability to analyze the process of order building, optimize the loading workflow, and select the most efficient pick and load path.
  • Managing various processes at the same time is a fundamental part of maintaining an optimized system.
  • The skill of consistently counting incoming products and verifying them against the manifest is critical.
  • Consistently achieving accurate loading of trucks while following documentation requirements.
  • Exhibits superior interpersonal communication skills.
  • The job necessitates the ability to perform in extreme temperatures, noisy surroundings, slippery floors, and hazardous shards of glass.
  • Every once in a while, the requirement may arise to lift weights that exceed 25 pounds, although the frequency of such cases is low.
  • The capacity to remain seated for extended periods.
  • Regular movements on and off a forklift.
  • The opening and closing of truck dock doors play an essential role in the unloading and loading process.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Certification for forklift and pallet jack operation includes both theoretical and practical training to ensure safety and efficiency.
  • Switcher operation certification.
  • Obtaining a Class A commercial driver's license is mandatory in some cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Past familiarity with logistics handling.
  • It is critical to adhere to federal and state weight limitations to avoid fines and citations. Failing to comply with regulations can also lead to accidents and damage to the truck, trailer, and cargo.

Work Environment:

  • An environment that is both loud and lacks temperature regulation, varying between both high and low degrees.

Employment opportunities are available to qualified individuals, without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
